summary: Keep native timeline projections conformant to the existing client schema

replay.detail: Native timelines remain owner-local reads; fractional durations are rounded to whole contract units and incomplete optional views retain their original native payloads.

schema.detail: No database or client-v0 schema change.

compatibility.detail: Fixes integer duration and boolean configured projections, missing job identity/state and tool-start timestamps, and undeclared truncation fields so existing clients can decode producer output. The separately tracked daemon-sender schema gap remains unchanged.

downtime.detail: No additional interruption or service lifecycle change.

recovery.detail: No durable state or recovery changes.
